import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int maxn = 8;
    static final int SZ = 1048576 + 5;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static int sum_modulo(int a, int b) {
        int res = a + b;
        return res >= MOD ? res - MOD : res;
    }

    static int diff_modulo(int a, int b) {
        return a >= b ? a - b : a + MOD - b;
    }

    static int mul_mod(int a, int b) {
        return (int)((1L * a * b) % MOD);
    }

    static void add_to(int[] arr, int index, int y) {
        arr[index] = sum_modulo(arr[index], y);
    }

    static int pow_modulo(int base, int exp) {
        int res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = mul_mod(res, base);
            base = mul_mod(base, base);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int n;
    static int[][] a = new int[maxn][maxn];
    static int inv100;
    static int[][] g = new int[maxn][maxn];
    static int[] p = new int[SZ];
    static int[][][] num = new int[7][7][7];
    static int total_mask;
    static int answer;

    static boolean check_permutation(int x, int y, int z) {
        int[] perm = {1, 2, 3};
        int[] order = {x, y, z};
        do {
            boolean valid = true;
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                if (g[perm[i]][order[i]] == 0) {
                    valid = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (valid) return true;
        } while (next_permutation(perm));
        return false;
    }

    static boolean next_permutation(int[] arr) {
        int i = arr.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && arr[i] >= arr[i + 1]) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = arr.length - 1;
        while (arr[j] <= arr[i]) j--;
        swap(arr, i, j);
        reverse(arr, i + 1, arr.length - 1);
        return true;
    }

    static void swap(int[] arr, int i, int j) {
        int tmp = arr[i]; arr[i] = arr[j]; arr[j] = tmp;
    }

    static void reverse(int[] arr, int start, int end) {
        while (start < end) {
            swap(arr, start++, end--);
        }
    }

    static void dfs1(int val, int row, int col) {
        boolean[] used = new boolean[7];
        if (val == 0 && row == 4 && col == 1) {
            int dummy = 0; dummy++;
        }
        if (val == 0) return;
        if (row == 4) {
            Arrays.fill(used, true);
            int state = 0;
            if (val != 0) {
                int dummy = 0; dummy++;
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (check_permutation(i, j, k)) {
                            int X = -1, Y = -1, Z = -1;
                            used[i] = used[j] = used[k] = false;
                            for (int l = 1; l <= 6; l++) {
                                if (!used[l]) continue;
                                if (X == -1) X = l;
                                else if (Y == -1) Y = l;
                                else Z = l;
                            }
                            used[i] = used[j] = used[k] = true;
                            if (Z == -1) continue;
                            state |= num[X][Y][Z];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            add_to(p, state, val);
            return;
        }
        g[row][col] = 1; 
        int next_val = mul_mod(val, a[row][col]);
        if (col == 6) dfs1(next_val, row + 1, 1);
        else dfs1(next_val, row, col + 1);
        g[row][col] = 0; 
        int next_val_sub = mul_mod(val, diff_modulo(1, a[row][col]));
        if (col == 6) dfs1(next_val_sub, row + 1, 1);
        else dfs1(next_val_sub, row, col + 1);
    }

    static void dfs2(int val, int row, int col) {
        if (val == 0) return;
        if (row == 7) {
            int state = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (check_permutation(i, j, k)) state |= num[i][j][k];
                    }
                }
            }
            add_to(p, answer, mul_mod(val, p[total_mask ^ state]));
            return;
        }
        g[row - 3][col] = 1; 
        int next_val = mul_mod(val, a[row][col]);
        if (col == 6) dfs2(next_val, row + 1, 1);
        else dfs2(next_val, row, col + 1);
        g[row - 3][col] = 0; 
        int next_val_sub = mul_mod(val, diff_modulo(1, a[row][col]));
        if (col == 6) dfs2(next_val_sub, row + 1, 1);
        else dfs2(next_val_sub, row, col + 1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        inv100 = pow_modulo(100, MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = mul_mod(sc.nextInt(), inv100);
            }
        }
        for (int i = n + 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            a[i][i] = 1;
        }
        int cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                    num[i][j][k] = 1 << cnt;
                    cnt++;
                }
            }
        }
        total_mask = (1 << cnt) - 1;
        Arrays.fill(p, 0);
        dfs1(1, 1, 1);
        for (int j = 0; j < cnt; j++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << cnt); i++) {
                if ((i & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                    add_to(p, i, p[i ^ (1 << j)]);
                }
            }
        }
        answer = 0;
        dfs2(1, 4, 1);
        answer = diff_modulo(1, answer);
        System.out.println(answer);
        sc.close();
    }
}
